rows.grounds: Compound brāhmī-ādi-loka-pālāḥ (beginning with Brāhmī, world-guardians) conjoined with indeclinable ca; nominative plural masculine.
Compound ṣoḍaśa-dvāra-saṃsthitāḥ (situated at sixteen gates); nominative plural masculine.

items.question: Which world-guardians beginning with Brāhmī are stationed at the sixteen gates?
premises: The guardians are led by Brāhmī.
They are stationed at sixteen gates.
items.inference: Therefore, the Brāhmī-led world-guardians occupy the sixteen gates.
items.plain_english: And the world-guardians beginning with Brāhmī are stationed at the sixteen gates.
